description: Return the repo files a recipe change may edit for one part of the recipe: element gates (mushi.recipe.json budgets and cadence), env (.env.example declarations) or routes (the inventory file). Each file has { path, exists, content, sha, writable, reason }, read from the default branch head; a file over 512 KB or one containing something shaped like a secret has content null. Pass each sha as baseSha to propose_recipe_change so a file that changed since is refused. Optional projectId. Returns { ok, element, branch, headSha, files } or { ok: false, reason }. Read-only.

element.description: gates (mushi.recipe.json budgets), env (.env.example) or routes (the inventory file)

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to the server-configured project when omitted (`project_id` is accepted too.)

name: get_recipe_sources
title: Recipe source files
